context: Friends plan summer activities — sushi, fireworks, late-night noodles
purpose: Teach: 寿司/麺/花火/親切/暗い/天井/払う/終わら

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 夏休み、何しよっか。とりあえずお寿司は外せないよね。
lines.en: What should we do over summer break? We can't skip sushi for sure.
lines.style: Casual, upbeat, slightly drawn-out vowels typical of a relaxed university student.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 賛成！あと花火大会も絶対行きたい。先輩、めっちゃ親切に誘ってくれてありがとう。
lines.en: Agreed! I really want to hit the fireworks festival too. Thanks for being so kind and inviting me.
lines.style: Energetic teenage tone, quick tempo, with admiring inflection toward an older friend.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いやいや、こっちこそ。花火のあと、夜遅くにラーメンの麺すすりに行かない？
lines.en: Nah, same here. After the fireworks, wanna go slurp some ramen noodles late at night?
lines.style: Warm, easygoing reply with a casual invitation, soft rising intonation at the end.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 行く行く！この前見つけた店、天井が低くて雰囲気いいんだよね。
lines.en: Yes, let's go! This place I found recently has a low ceiling and a really nice vibe.
lines.style: Excited overlap, leaning forward in conversation, friendly teen excitement.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: へえ、いいじゃん。お会計はどうする？今回は俺が払うよ、バイト代入ったし。
lines.en: Oh nice. How should we handle the bill? I'll pay this time since I just got my part-time check.
lines.style: Generous offer, lightly proud, casual masculine sentence-final particle usage.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: マジで！？じゃあ次は俺がおごるね。でも店、暗いから道に迷わないようにしよ。
lines.en: Seriously? Then I'll treat you next time. But the shop's dark, so let's not get lost on the way.
lines.style: Surprised, grateful, then practical — youthful and slightly hurried delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 大丈夫、地図あるし。今年の夏、楽しいことが終わらないといいな。
lines.en: We're fine, I've got the map. I hope this summer's fun never ends.
lines.style: Reassuring, then reflective and warm — a quieter, sentimental closing tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ほんとそれ！じゃあ来週、寿司屋に集合ね。
lines.en: Totally! Okay, let's meet up at the sushi place next week then.
lines.style: Bright, conclusive teen energy wrapping up the plan with cheerful confirmation.
